subject.title: Feature Request: Add cumulative history search and multi-account support

question: Should Wacrawl adopt cumulative archival as a supported storage model, and should isolated multi-account profiles land in the same product slice or as separate work?
rationale: Current point-in-time snapshot semantics are intentional and safe; choosing federation versus merged storage, account identity, migration behavior, and backup layout is product and data-model policy rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Stage the work
options.body: Define and ship account isolation first, then design cumulative retention or federated search as a separately reviewed archive-model change.

options.title: Approve one combined archive redesign
options.body: Treat profiles and cumulative deduplicated history as one coordinated storage migration with explicit upgrade and backup compatibility guarantees.

recommendation.title: Stage the work
recommendation.body: Define and ship account isolation first, then design cumulative retention or federated search as a separately reviewed archive-model change.

likelyOwner.reason: The current snapshot and encrypted-backup model traces to their merged feature work.
